propuesta.prompt: @image1 is a real photo of Pulpo a la gallega with prawns on sliced potatoes at a restaurant. Use it only as the list of elements, not as a layout to copy. The new photograph must contain the same real elements: curled grilled octopus tentacle scored into slices; peeled cooked prawns with tails; sliced boiled potatoes; green herb oil drizzle; red paprika dusting; round grooved wooden board; slate-blue underplate. Exactly 1 × curled grilled octopus tentacle scored into slices; 3 × peeled cooked prawns with tails. Nothing else added. New composition by a professional food photographer: Slightly high three-quarter view rotated 60 degrees, framing the entire wooden board and underplate uncut in the lower-right, 50 mm lens at f/5.6, Whole round plate complete and uncut in the lower-right, leaving clean empty space at top-left for the vertical headline and cut-out layout, on a clean, plain, uniform background with even light around the whole dish, so it can be cut out cleanly. Bright, even studio light from the upper left with a crisp short contact shadow and sharp highlights on the glossy oil and octopus skin, Clean neutral background with saturated warm terracotta-red paprika and golden-orange prawns as the strong punchy accents. Overall aesthetic: bright, even studio light with crisp contact shadows; a clean, plain, uniform background that makes the dish easy to cut out; no props: only the dish on its real tableware; saturated, punchy colours; the whole dish inside the frame, not cut by any edge, from a slightly high three-quarter view. Photographic realism, no text. Editorial direction: Leave quiet negative space at the bottom for separate typesetting. Keep the characteristic colours of the ingredients consistent. Render no lettering or graphics.
